A Beautifully Finished Luxury 5 Bedroom Home extending to C.486.84 sq.mtrs/5240 sq.ft. situated 3km from the Main N3 Virginia/Dublin Rd and C.1 hour from Dublin Airport.
This fantastic property comes to the market in pristine condition throughout with no outlay required and many extra features included.
The interior of the property is thoughtfully designed to offer both comfort and elegance. The entrance hall makes an immediate impression with its bespoke staircase introducing the sense of style and quality that defines the rest of the home.
Mature gardens and lawns are carefully manicured and maintained extending to C.2 acres complete with Tennis Court (with option to purchase a further 5 acres of agri lands)
